Latin word

Em!

here!, handing something over; there! (showing, or pointing to what has happened); there! look! (pointing something out)

In this lexicon

  • here you are

    the recommended word · classical · Traupman 109: accipe, em; Traupman 405

  • there!

    the recommended word · classical · Plaut. Aul. 641: Em tibi, ostendī, eccās.; Plaut. Men. 625b: Em rūrsum nunc nūgās agis.

  • well …

    also used · classical · Ter. Eun. 3.2.6 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 405
